issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'הָפֵ֤חַ בַּֽחוּרִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם' means 'all of them are a snare in pits' (or 'trapped in holes'), referring to people being ensnared/hidden in holes. The Chinese renders '一切戶珥都被摧毀' ('all Hur are destroyed'), which misinterprets 'בַּֽחוּרִים' (pits/holes) as the proper name 'Hur' (חוּר) and adds 'destroyed' (摧毀) not present in the Hebrew. This changes the meaning from people being trapped in pits to a destruction of a person/place named Hur.
